title: Kaisen Cursed offical modpack
description: This modpack is meant for the minecraft server "Kaisen Cursed".
body:
This modpack was made for the Kaisen Cursed minecraft server. It adds multiple things related to the popular anime jujutsu kaisen, such as: Cursed Techniques, different structures, many many unique abilities and traits. One of the main mods of the pack is JJK: Cursed fate which most of the mods in here are based around.



**DISCLAIMER:** Do not trust anyone that says they have the "offical" modpack/files for it especially if it comes from an unknown person that you do not trust. Please do not download these, the only offical download of the modpack is either on the offical discord server or this exact modrinth page.

Offical [DISCORD](https://discord.gg/kKSPQUf4) link.
